sets.relationshipLabel: a catalyst elevates the protagonist from lowly origins to royal status
sets.explanation: Both Simba and Cinderella rise from humble circumstance to a royal title through a defining turn of fortune.

sets.relationshipLabel: an external event thrusts an unavoidable, destined role onto the protagonist
sets.explanation: Neither Frodo nor Harry chose their burden—prophecy and circumstance handed each of them a role they could not refuse.

sets.relationshipLabel: an act of virtue transforms a non-human or cursed being into a true, living form
sets.explanation: Love breaks the Beast's curse and honesty earns Pinocchio his humanity—virtue is the mechanism, not magic alone.

sets.relationshipLabel: an internal or chemical trigger unleashes an uncontrollable alternate persona
sets.explanation: Rage and a fateful potion each strip away control, revealing a darker second self neither man can suppress.
